<!-- All news items below this line -->

;Armed conflicts and attacks
*The [[Combined Joint Task Force – Operation Inherent Resolve|American-led coalition]] issues a statement saying that 11 U.S. service members were injured by the [[2020 Iranian attack on U.S. forces in Iraq|January 8, 2020 attack]] by [[Iran]] on [[U.S. forces]] in [[Iraq]]. The [[United States Department of Defense|U.S. Department of Defense]] had initially assessed that there had been no injuries. [https://www.cnn.com/2020/01/16/politics/service-members-injured-iran-strike/index.html (CNN)]

;Arts and culture
*[[LGBT rights in South Korea]]
**In a landmark case, the [[South Korean military]] is set to decide on the first [[transgender]] soldier's possible discharge. The soldier underwent [[Sex reassignment surgery|surgery]] overseas and is stationed in [[Gyeonggi Province]]. The case sparks a national debate on [[LGBT]] issues in the military, which punishes [[Gay sexual practices|sex between two males]] with up to two years imprisonment. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-southkorea-military-transgender/south-korea-to-decide-on-first-transgender-soldier-amid-debate-idUSKBN1ZF1S0?il=0 (Reuters)]

;Business and economy
*The [[United States Senate|U.S. Senate]] votes 89–10 to pass the [[United States–Mexico–Canada Agreement]]. Once ratified by [[Canada]], it will supersede the [[North America Free Trade Agreement]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-trade-usmca/senate-passes-north-america-trade-deal-canada-still-to-approve-idUSKBN1ZF283?il=0 (Reuters)]
*[[Alphabet Inc.]], parent company of [[Google]], becomes the fourth American company to hit a stock [[market capitalization]] of [[U.S. dollar|US$]]1 trillion. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-funds-google/which-company-just-hit-1-trillion-google-it-idUSKBN1ZF2SH (Reuters)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[January 2020 North American storm complex|Winter Storm Jacob]] continues to move eastwards across the northern United States, bringing up to {{convert|26|in|cm}} of snowfall from [[Montana]] to [[Idaho]] and [[Utah]] and down into the [[Sierra Nevada]] of [[California]]. [https://weather.com/storms/winter/news/2020-01-12-mid-january-snow-ice-rain-storm-west-midwest-northeast (The Weather Channel)]

;International relations
*[[President of Guatemala|Guatemalan President]] [[Alejandro Giammattei]] cuts ties with [[Presidency of Nicolás Maduro|the government]] of disputed [[President of Venezuela|Venezuelan President]] [[Nicolás Maduro]] and closes [[Guatemala]]'s embassy in [[Caracas]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-guatemala-politics-venezuela/guatemalas-new-president-cuts-ties-with-venezuela-as-promised-idUSKBN1ZF2SB?il=0 (Reuters)]

;Law and crime
*After his escape from [[Japan]], [[Carlos Ghosn]]'s Japanese lawyer Junichiro Hironaka and seven other members of his defense resign. Hironaka says Ghosn's escape was a "complete surprise". [https://edition.cnn.com/2020/01/16/business/carlos-ghosn-lawyer/index.html (CNN Business)]
*The bodies of seven people are found in a [[mass grave]] in the indigenous [[Ngäbe-Buglé Comarca|Ngäbe-Buglé]] region of [[Panama]]. Authorities believe a religious sect performed an [[exorcism]] on the victims. Police rescued 15 people who had  suffered bodily injuries. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-51144629 (BBC News)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Mikhail Mishustin]] is appointed as new  [[Prime Minister of Russia]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/2020/01/16/world/europe/mikhail-mishustin.html (''The New York Times'')]
